name: @topo/web
description: Structural intelligence for codebases — interactive visualization of domains, health, and issues.

scripts.build:wasm: cd ../topo-analyzer && wasm-pack build --target web --features wasm --no-default-features --out-dir pkg && cp pkg/topo_analyzer_bg.wasm ../topo-web/wasm/ && cp pkg/topo_analyzer.js ../topo-web/wasm/ && cp pkg/topo_analyzer.d.ts ../topo-web/wasm/
